{{Quote|Once you're in place, you can use a laser drill and microcord camera to tap the wall.|Raina Temple|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''microcord camera''' was a small kind of camera that could snake through lengthy holes. [[Cipher Nine]] used a microcord camera to survey a meeting on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after creating an opening with a [[Laserdrill/Legends|laser drill]].
